column3: Everything in this catalogue is suitable for planting between September and December. All seed is tested for germination each July and the result is printed on every packet.
A reliable softneck with large white bulbs that store until the following May. Plant each clove with its tip just below the surface.
A hardneck garlic with purple-streaked skins and a mild, sweet flavour. The bulbs are ready from late June.
Each bulb weighs up to 300 grams and the cloves are easy to peel.

The classic autumn sowing, hardy to minus ten degrees. Pods of seven to nine beans appear in May.
A compact variety about 60 cm tall that needs no staking.
Sow 5 cm deep and 20 cm apart in a double row.
Cover with fleece during hard frosts.
Pinch out the growing tips when the first pods set to deter blackfly.
A Japanese variety that overwinters well and matures a month earlier than spring sets. It stores until March when dried properly.
Red-skinned, with sweet crisp rings for salads. Plant sets 10 cm apart with the tip showing.
A very hardy leek that stands in the ground until April. Sow in a seedbed and transplant in June.
Blue-green leaves turn violet in the cold, and the stems are thick and tender. It is best lifted after the first hard frost.
A small cos lettuce with a sweet, crisp heart. It will crop under cloches from November to March.
Hardy butterhead that survives temperatures well below freezing. Sow in a cold frame in the first half of October.
A red-tinged romaine with an upright habit. It is happy in a window box as well as a bed.
Long copper-skinned bulbs with a delicate flavour. Plant in February or in autumn in free-draining soil.
A round red shallot that keeps its colour when cooked. Each set gives six to eight bulbs.
A pointed variety that can be cut as greens in March or left to heart. Sow in August and plant out in October.
Small hearts of about 500 grams on plants only 30 cm apart. Suited to small gardens and large pots.
A one metre roll of horticultural fleece protects a bed of beans through a week of frost.
Fleece roll, 1.5 m by 10 m, with 12 pegs.
Glass cloche, set of two, with steel clips.
Bulb planter with a stainless steel blade.
